newsitem.title: USA: Antivirals expects to file FDA new drug app.
newsitem.headline: Antivirals expects to file FDA new drug app.

text.p: Antivirals Inc said Thursday it expects to file an Investigational New Drug application with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to begin human clinical trials in 1998 of its antisense agent called neo-gene.
The company said it will file the applications based on the continued success of its pre-clinical trials.

The company said pre-clinical studies of its neo-gene antisense agents found they are effective in targeting a specific gene function - called c-myc -- that triggers cell division in the artery wall that leads to restenosis.
The company said restenosis is the leading contributor of the 30 percent to 50 percent failure rate in the 1.2 million angioplasties performed annually worldwide.
